findings.fix: In `InnerIntegrationByParts.lean`, state two public lemmas, e.g. `TestFunction.integrableOn_im_pos_inner_of_memLpLoc` and `TestFunction.integrableOn_im_pos_inner_fderiv_of_memLpLoc`, and use them at all three sites. findings.issue: Lines 70-74 and 129-133 define the same local helpers `hpos`, `hi` and `hd` word for word: pairings of `φ` and `∂_v φ` with a field locally `L¹` up to the axis are integrable on `{0 < im}`. `InnerIntegrationByParts.lean:129-133` repeats `hpos` and both integrability terms inline. This is a reusable fact hidden inside three proofs.

findings.evidence: Green.lean:143-146: `rw [integral_add _ i4, integral_sub _ i3, integral_sub _ i2, integral_neg, integral_add _ i4, integral_add i5 i6]` · `linarith` then `exacts [...]`.
findings.fix: Split the integrals with a single `integral_add`/`integral_sub` step on a stated `have` that matches the shape of `inner_crFormalAdjoint`. Alternatively, prove a pointwise identity and use `integral_congr` followed by one `integral_add`/`integral_sub` step, so the side goals no longer depend on rewrite order.
findings.issue: Green's formula ends with six named integral rewrites (`integral_add _ i4, integral_sub _ i3, integral_sub _ i2, integral_neg, integral_add _ i4, integral_add i5 i6`). Their integrability side goals are then closed by position in `exacts [i5.add i6, i1.neg, i1.neg.sub i2, (i1.neg.sub i2).sub i3]`. Changing the `simp only [inner_crFormalAdjoint]` normal form or the goal order breaks it, and it obscures why the proof works.

findings.fix: Use `mem_setOf_eq ▸ hz`, or write `(hz : 0 < z.im).le` after `rw [mem_setOf_eq] at hz`. Better, change the binder to `(hz : 0 < z.im)` and use `hz.le` at both sites.
findings.issue: `show (0 : ℝ) ≤ z.im from le_of_lt hz` has no comment and relies on `z ∈ {z | 0 < z.im}` unfolding by definition to `0 < z.im`. The same pattern appears at line 86.

summary: The proofs build but repeat the same block of integrability facts three times instead of stating it once as a lemma, and Green's formula ends with a long chain of named rewrites. Two `show` steps without a comment rely on set membership unfolding by definition.
